properties.markdownProperty:
A **Local figure** shows an image file stored **inside the project** (in its `assets` folder). Its *File* property names the image, *Width (%)* sets how much of the page width it takes, and *Description* is the caption. Because the image travels with the project, the figure displays even without an Internet connection.
Local figures and remote figures come from different archetypes but share the *figure* class, so they are treated the same way in traces and templates.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **Yes**. It has the `traceable-object` class, so the *Dependencies* of other objects can point to it (it can also be the target of a symbolic link). - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**. *Authors* and *Sources* point to stakeholders, and *Dependencies* point to any traceable object.
